exposure: Prolonged second stage of labor (PSS) in twin deliveries
outcome: Composite adverse maternal outcomes (episiotomy, chorioamnionitis, endometritis, blood product transfusion)
Vacuum deliveries of the first and second twin
cohort: Women with twin pregnancies, first fetus in vertex presentation, attempted vaginal delivery with epidural analgesia, reached the second stage of labor, at an academic medical center between 2005 and 2019
finding: The study found that prolonged second stage of labor of the presenting twin was associated with an adverse composite maternal outcome in nulliparous women and with postpartum hemorrhage in multiparous women.
